description: Provides bottom-sheet components for React Native.

latest_release.name: v1.1.0
latest_release.body:
## Overview

- addressed: #87, #95, #131
- external contributors: @Gnative

## Changes

- Added `maxWidth` and `placement` to `BottomSheet` and `ModalBottomSheet` on iOS, Android, and web. Both props can change while the sheet is open.
  - Set `maxWidth` to cap the sheet’s width in points, including the detent’s side `insets`. Narrower containers still use their available width. Omit `maxWidth` or pass `Infinity` for no cap.
  - Set `placement` to align the sheet when the cap leaves extra space. The default is `'center'`. Use `'start'` or `'end'` to align it with the corresponding edge in the current layout direction.
- Reduced stuttering on iOS while a sheet animates to a detent.
- Fixed a final-frame jump on iOS, Android, and web. The sheet now slows to a stop at its target detent, most noticeably when opening from closed to full height.

hot_issues.title: [iOS] `lazy` + `'content'` detent: reopening after expanding to a higher detent crashes with "Detents must be passed in ascending order"
[BottomSheet] `@react-navigation/stack` header draws over an open sheet on iOS
[Feature request] First-class support for nested draggable / long-press pan gestures (e.g. react-native-draggable-flatlist reorder)
[Feature request] Native footer slot pinned to the sheet's visible bottom edge
Feature request: opt-in native keyboard avoidance
